page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred above the text. No page number, catchword only at the bottom right ("De"), no marginal notes.

main_text.p: tegrè[?] tractata, aut pars disciplinæ, aut denique duarum vel plurium disciplinarum farrago. In quibus tradendis ita sum versatus, ut ex sacris literis defumpferim vel res, vel methodum, vel exempla: & rursum res, vel αὐτολεξεὶ[?], vel per bo-nam consequentiam. Tuum est, lector Christiane, hunc nostrum laborem benigne interpretari, at-que ita apud animum statuere tu-um, optimum philosophandi, ge-nus esse, si quis ex Bibliis petat ἱμα ἢ ποδήρη[?], vestem & purpuram, laudatissimi huius studij. Ita e-nim fit, ut iuventus reddat sibi familiarem hunc sacratissimum codicem, & coniungat pietatem cum eruditione, & ab his cer-tissimis initijs assurgat ad api-cem philosophiæ sobriæ & so-lidæ.

page.notes: The first word "tegrè" is a fragment from the previous page; its first letter is uncertain (possibly an ae ligature). Greek words αὐτολεξεὶ and ἱμα ἢ ποδήρη are uncertain in their accents and letters. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed. No page number is printed.
